q1.title: Eval harness: minimal mechanics
q1.imperative: Settle the minimal Claude-A/Claude-B shape: what a run looks like, where scenarios live, what evidence it produces, its seam with curator and install. Recommend; human decides.
q1.finding: DECIDED: autonomous eval harness, Euler-piloted. run_skill_eval.py + evals/ scenarios (fixture repo, task prompt driving a real workflow e.g. commander on a bounded Euler issue with crew, mechanical checks run by the runner: answer correct, tests green, artifacts present, spine JSON completed). Fresh headless agent per run; computed pass/fail; transcript for diagnosis only. Curator owns scenario-portfolio curation (downstream failures do not flow back - autonomous runs are the substitute signal); portfolio stays mixed over time (Euler alone will not stress architecture judgment).

consolidation.summary: Cycle 3 (single-question refine): eval harness converged - autonomous, Euler-piloted, curator-curated portfolio. All design decisions now closed; human directed converge to spec + route to Admiral epic.
